title: A Study to Assess Brillouin Hydration Mapping for the Evaluation of Ocular Tissues and Diseases
official: A Study to Assess Brillouin Hydration Mapping for the Evaluation of Ocular Tissues and Diseases
summary: The overall goal of this study is to develop Brillouin microscope as a novel tool for measuring biomechanical and hydration properties of human tissues in vivo.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy volunteers with normal eyes
* Visual acuity between +2 to -6 diopters

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of refractive or cataract surgery
* History of ocular disease
* Active non-ophthalmic systemic disease
